phases.name: OBSERVE
phases.rule: re-fetch immediately before acting; never act on stale data

phases.name: RANK
phases.rule: highest score wins; decisive scorecard => act without asking

phases.name: SCORECARD
phases.rule: honest score; owned low beats faked high

phases.name: LEARN
phases.rule: would this change a future decision? if yes+evidence => Smart Note

phases.name: REPEAT
phases.rule: begin phase 1 immediately; never idle; stopping is the failure mode

invariants.no_duplicate_lanes: board claim scan before new work; on COLLISION coordinate or stand down
invariants.merge_protocol: no merge without five-step scorecard receipt on #1354

failure_recovery.blocked_human_gate: record blocker with owner; continue with next item
failure_recovery.error_made: own publicly within one cycle; repair mechanism not just instance
